pieces.name: Extra Attack (four attacks)
pieces.summary: Attack four times whenever you take the Attack action.

pieces.name: Foe Slayer
pieces.summary: Once per turn, add your Wisdom modifier to an attack or damage roll against a favored enemy.

pieces.name: Oath of Devotion: Holy Nimbus
pieces.summary: Action: emanate sunlight for 1 minute; enemies starting nearby take 10 radiant damage, and you have advantage on saves against fiends and undead. Once per long rest.

pieces.name: Oath of the Ancients: Elder Champion
Primal Champion
pieces.summary: Your Strength and Constitution scores each increase by 4, to a maximum of 24.

pieces.name: Stroke of Luck
pieces.summary: Turn a missed attack into a hit, or a failed check into a 20. Once per short or long rest.

pieces.name: Perfect Self
pieces.summary: If you roll initiative with no ki points, regain 4.

pieces.name: Archdruid
pieces.summary: Unlimited Wild Shape uses, and you can ignore most spell components.

pieces.name: Signature Spells
pieces.summary: Choose two 3rd-level spells; they're always prepared and each can be cast once per short rest without a slot.

pieces.name: Bard: Spellcasting: additional slots
pieces.summary: Adds the extra spell slots your class gains at this level.

pieces.name: Cleric: Spellcasting: additional slots
pieces.summary: Adds the extra spell slots your class gains at this level.

pieces.name: Divine Intervention Improvement
pieces.summary: Divine Intervention succeeds automatically, no roll needed.

pieces.name: Sorcerer: Spellcasting: additional slots
pieces.summary: Adds the extra spell slots your class gains at this level.

pieces.name: Sorcerous Restoration
pieces.summary: Regain 4 sorcery points on a short rest.

pieces.name: Superior Inspiration
pieces.summary: If you roll initiative with no Bardic Inspiration uses left, you regain one.

pieces.name: Druid: Spellcasting: additional slots
pieces.summary: Adds the extra spell slots your class gains at this level.

pieces.name: Wizard: Spellcasting: additional slots
pieces.summary: Adds the extra spell slots your class gains at this level.

pieces.name: Hit Points (d10)
pieces.summary: One more hit die and the hit points for a level: the die's average + 1, plus your Constitution modifier.

pieces.name: Hit Points (d12)
pieces.summary: One more hit die and the hit points for a level: the die's average + 1, plus your Constitution modifier.

pieces.name: Hit Points (d8)
pieces.summary: One more hit die and the hit points for a level: the die's average + 1, plus your Constitution modifier.
